lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: Hey, sorry to bother you,

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: but is this Commander {AccountData.NickName}'s number?
Yes.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: Phew, that's a relief.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: I have a request to make.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: Can you take me up to the surface?

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: I'll pay you, of course.
Why do you want to go there?

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: It's rather embarrassing to admit, especially when we've just met, but

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: I'm in quite a bit of debt.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: Not through any fault of my own, mind you.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: It's just that I've inherited it from my parents.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: As a result, I've been working ever since I was young.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: Despite that, it turns out that I've only paid off 10%

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: when I went to check a while ago.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: It's like a bad joke!

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: I can't live like this for the rest of my life.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: Instead, I want to run off to the surface.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: They won't be able to follow me up there, right?
It's too dangerous up there.
Is there nowhere else you can hide?

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: It's okay.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: Either I stay here and work myself to death, or die up on the surface.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: It's all the same.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: I suppose I can donate my brain and become a Nikke...

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: No, I'd rather take my chances on the surface.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: According to this collector I met, these coordinates lead to

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: a route where ordinary people can travel freely without any armed escorts.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: After we meet there,

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: you can drop me off at a nearby bunker.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: I'll wait for you there.
